proposals.before: Yet Weihan was bold in action. Surveying strategic points, he converted the Lzhou Guard thousand-household post into Qingxi County.
proposals.after: Yet Weihan was bold in action. Surveying strategic points, he converted the Lizhou Guard thousand-household post into Qingxi County.
proposals.reason: 黎州 is Lizhou, not Lzhou; the fused romanization obscures the place name.

proposals.before: Yet Weihan was bold in undertaking affairs; surveying key points, he changed the Lzhou Guard thousand-household post and established Qingxi County.
proposals.after: Yet Weihan was bold in undertaking affairs; surveying key points, he changed the Lizhou Guard thousand-household post and established Qingxi County.
proposals.reason: 黎州 is Lizhou; Lzhou is a corrupted romanization of the place name.

proposals.before: Censor Wu Tao had falsified land surveys in eastern Sichuan, and Weihan was sent to assist the investigation.
proposals.after: Censor Wu Tao had surveyed land falsely in eastern Sichuan, and Weihan was sent to assist him.
proposals.reason: Chinese 以維翰助之 means Weihan was sent to assist Wu Tao, not a separate investigation; the next sentence shows he then replaced Wu Tao.

proposals.before: The commentator writes: Qi Yuan was deeply versed in the classics. When court governance favored severity, he maintained fairness and forbearance.
proposals.after: The commentator writes: Qiyuan was deeply versed in the classics. When court governance favored severity, he maintained fairness and forbearance.
proposals.reason: 起元 is elsewhere rendered Qiyuan as one word; the spaced Qi Yuan obscures identity with Shen Qiyuan.

decisions.reason: Chinese 黎州 is Lizhou; Lzhou drops the medial vowel and corrupts the place name. The proposed idiomatic keeps the rest of the accurate wording and only restores Lizhou.
Chinese 黎州 is Lizhou; Lzhou is a corrupted romanization. The proposed literal corrects only that place name while preserving the accurate establishment wording.

以維翰助之 means Weihan was assigned to assist Wu Tao (之), not to assist a separate investigation; 丈田不實 is surveying land inaccurately. The proposed idiomatic restores both points, and s0131’s replacement follows from assisting him first.
起元 is already rendered accurately as Qi Yuan; collapsing the spaced given name to Qiyuan is only romanization-style consistency with Shen Qiyuan elsewhere, not a semantic correction of the Chinese.
